notes: 2026-10-29 (zumiez page run): homepage title 'Zumiez - Clothing Stores for Skate shoes, Skateboards, Snowboards, & Streetwear'; nav Deals, New Arrivals, Men, Women, Kids, Shoes, Accessories, Skate, Snow, Gift Cards, Brands, Sale; banner 'Free Shipping on Orders Over $64.94'. known_for is built from that title.

About page: founded 'in Seattle in 1978 by Tom Campion' as 'a single store called Above the Belt'; 'over 700+ stores across North America and Europe'; sells 'apparel, footwear, and accessories to skate hardgoods and lifestyle products'; describes itself as 'a global destination connecting young people with the products, brands, and lifestyles that help them individuate'. Names Ninth Hall, Pro Club and Sprayground among brands carried.

Shipping: free economy shipping on qualifying orders to the contiguous US over $64.94 (FedEx or USPS, 3–10 business days); Alaska, Hawaii and APO/FPO not eligible; free ship-to-store with no minimum; 3-Day Shipping $8.95 flat on orders $59.95+. International destinations pay 'standard international rates' (countries not named), so ships_to records only the US. A separate zumiez.ca site serves Canada.

Returns: full refund or exchange to the original payment within 30 days; after 30 days, a gift card. Mail-in returns pay their own postage ('Shipping costs are non-refundable'); returning in a store is described as 'the FAST and FREE way'.
Store list (zumiez.com/stores/list, 'All Zumiez Stores', by US state): e.g. California 85, Florida 36, Colorado 20, Georgia 17, Illinois 15 (read through Missouri; page truncated). us_stores true.

Sizes: Shaka Wear Max Heavyweight tee XS–3XL in the selector (size chart lists 4XL, 5XL); Santa Cruz x Pokémon Power Dot tee S–XXL ($31.95, 100% cotton). size_range detail: men's tees XS–3XL, varies by brand.

Wikipedia (Zumiez): founded 1978, first store at Seattle's Northgate Mall as 'Above the Belt'; founders Thomas D. Campion and Gary Haakenson; HQ Lynnwood, Washington (moved from Everett in 2012); Nasdaq: ZUMZ, public since 2005; acquired Blue Tomato (2012) and Fast Times (2015); 726 stores at Feb 3, 2018 (608 US, 52 Canada, 54 Europe, 12 Australia); infobox 739 worldwide (604 US) for 2021.

Category: mens-clothing (department).
